headline: BNP worker threatens to gouge out eyes of MP Muhammuddullah
summary: A BNP activist has issued a shocking threat against the Bangladesh Khelafat Majlis MP for Mymensingh-2.
details: A BNP worker has threatened to gouge out the eyes of Muhammuddullah, the Member of Parliament for the Mymensingh-2 (Fulpur-Tarakanda) constituency.
The MP is a member of the Bangladesh Khelafat Majlis.
The threat was issued by a BNP activist, creating tension in the political landscape of the region.

headline: 439 new hospitalizations as dengue death toll rises to 40
summary: One more person died in the last 24 hours, while hundreds of new patients were admitted to hospitals across Bangladesh.
details: One person died from dengue fever in the last 24 hours, bringing the total number of deaths this year to 40, according to a press release from the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) on Saturday.
caption:
Dengue deaths in Bangladesh have reached 40 this year, with 439 new patients hospitalized in just 24 hours.
